descriptions: This Arab West Report Interview Documentation Project dataset consists of 2 audio recordings of Cornelis Hulsman (Drs.) discussing media distortion and media critique at the Arab Thought Forum in 2007.
Both the summary and the lecture in the audio recording are in English.
